routes.label: Sum the arithmetic progression by pairing its ends.

question: A cart rolls down a hill, traveling \(5\) inches the first second and accelerating so that during each successive \(1\)-second time interval, it travels \(7\) inches more than during the previous \(1\)-second interval. The cart takes \(30\) seconds to reach the bottom of the hill. How far, in inches, does it travel?
solution:
The distances traveled during the successive seconds form an arithmetic sequence:
\[
5,\ 12,\ 19,\ldots,\ 5+29\cdot7=208.
\]
There are \(30\) terms. Pair the first with the last, the second with the next-to-last, and so on. Every pair sums to \(5+208=213\), and there are \(15\) pairs. Thus the total distance is
\[
15\cdot213=\boxed{3195}\text{ inches},
\]
choice D. The last term has \(29\) increases because the first second already contributes the initial \(5\) inches.
